verdicts.note: This meets the judicial safety gate because it is diversion evidence. In 2022 he said bringing treatment courts to district court 'is something that motivated me to run' (S3). In 2026 he wants a court engaged with employment, housing and treatment pathways (S5) and supported more treatment options for non-felony offenders (S4). The statements are consistent across two campaigns, so +1 medium. Not +2: he also says the judge's job is to apply the law (S4), and he has a prosecution background.

Attacked toward 0: she also supported more treatment options for non-felony offenders (S6). But her main statement (S5) is 'really hold people accountable' through treatment the judge mandates at reliable facilities rather than 'superficial' programs. Pole_a lists 'mandatory treatment', so the direction is right. The statement is about diversion and treatment, which meets the judicial gate. A single clear statement supports -1 medium.
